arsmagnaphilosophirum.name: Ars Magna - "Philosophirum"
arsmagnaphilosophirum.desc: Target up to 3 "Ars Magna" monsters in your field and/or GY; banish them, then you can negate the effects of up to that many other face-up cards on the field until the end of this turn. You can banish this card from your GY; return 1 "Power Patron" Link Monster from your GY into the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can only use 1 "Ars Magna - "Philosophirum"" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cloudiansmokeball.name: Cloudian - Smoke Ball
cloudiansmokeball.desc: Smoke Balls are newly born Cloudians. They fear being alone, and would rather swing and sway in the sky with their friends.

darkchimera.name: Dark Chimera
darkchimera.desc: ''A fire-breathing monster that dwells in the netherworld.''

darktunercatastrogue.name: Dark Tuner Catastrogue
darktunercatastrogue.desc: You can reveal this card in your hand; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 "Dark Tuner" monster. You can only use this effect of "Dark Tuner Catastrogue" once per turn. Once per turn, if you control this Normal Summoned/Set card: You can Tribute both this face-up card and 1 face-up non-Tuner with a lower Level, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck with a Level equal to the difference in Levels of those monsters (this is treated as a Synchro Summon), then you can destroy 1 card your opponent controls.

evomiracle.name: Evo-Miracle
evomiracle.desc: Target 1 monster that was Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster; this turn, it cannot be destroyed by battle or by card effects.

firewallsaberdragon.name: Firewall Saber Dragon
firewallsaberdragon.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target 1 Cyberse monster in your GY or banishment; add it to your hand. You can target 1 other Cyberse monster you control with a Level; this card's Level becomes that monster's. If this card is sent to the GY as Link Material: You can add 1 "A.I." Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Firewall Saber Dragon" once per turn.

gianttrunade.name: Giant Trunade
gianttrunade.desc: Return all Spell and Trap Cards on the field to the hand.

gleipnirthefettersoffenrir.name: Gleipnir, the Fetters of Fenrir
gleipnirthefettersoffenrir.desc: Add 1 "Nordic" monster from your Deck to your hand.

gravelure.name: Grave Lure
gravelure.desc: Turn the top card of your opponent's Deck face-up, then your opponent shuffles their Deck. When your opponent draws the face-up card, immediately send it to the Graveyard.

hazyflameperyton.name: Hazy Flame Peryton
hazyflameperyton.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned, except by a "Hazy Flame" monster's effect. Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects. You can send 1 FIRE monster from your hand to the Graveyard and Tribute this card; Special Summon 2 "Hazy Flame" monsters from your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Hazy Flame Peryton" once per turn.

heosvarogthemechanicaldawn.name: Heosvarog the Mechanical Dawn
heosvarogthemechanicaldawn.desc:
2 LIGHT Machine monsters
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can activate this effect; during the Standby Phase of the next turn, add 1 card from your GY to your hand, with an effect that Fusion Summons a monster(s). When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 face-up LIGHT Machine monster you control or 2 LIGHT Machine monsters from your GY; negate the activation. You can only use each effect of "Heosvarog the Mechanical Dawn" once per turn.

mahaamathefairydragon.name: Mahaama the Fairy Dragon
mahaamathefairydragon.desc:
During your opponent's turn, when either player takes battle damage: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then apply 1 of these effects.
● Gain LP equal to that battle damage.
● Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that battle damage.

mimirofthenordicascendant.name: Mimir of the Nordic Ascendant
mimirofthenordicascendant.desc: Once per turn, at the start of your Standby Phase, if you control a "Nordic" monster and this card is in your GY: You can send 1 Spell from your hand to the GY; Special Summon this card.

naturiacosmobeet.name: Naturia Cosmobeet
naturiacosmobeet.desc: When your opponent Normal Summons or Sets a monster, you can Special Summon this card from your hand.

secretsixsamuraikizaru.name: Secret Six Samurai - Kizaru
secretsixsamuraikizaru.desc: When this card is Special Summoned: You can add from your Deck to your hand, 1 "Six Samurai" monster with a different Attribute from every monster you control. If exactly 1 "Six Samurai" monster you control (and no other cards) would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

speedroiddominobutterfly.name: Speedroid Dominobutterfly
speedroiddominobutterfly.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except WIND monsters. This effect cannot be negated. You can discard 1 WIND monster, then target 1 of your banished WIND monsters; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Speedroid Dominobutterfly" once per turn.

[ Monster Effect ] 
Cannot be used as a Synchro Material, except for the Synchro Summon of a WIND Dragon or Machine-Type Synchro Monster. If this card, Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, is used as a Material for a Synchro Summon, banish it.

spiritualbeastrampengu.name: Spiritual Beast Rampengu
spiritualbeastrampengu.desc: Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Ritual Beast" monster from your Extra Deck and send 1 "Ritual Beast" monster with the same Type as that monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. You can only Special Summon "Spiritual Beast Rampengu(s)" once per turn.

spiritualfireartkurenai.name: Spiritual Fire Art - Kurenai
spiritualfireartkurenai.desc: Tribute 1 FIRE monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

superdreadnoughtrailcannongustavrocket.name: Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket
superdreadnoughtrailcannongustavrocket.desc:
3 Level 10 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket" by discarding 1 card and using 1 "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max" you control (transfer its materials). When your opponent activates a monster effect, while this card has material (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card, then inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. You can only use this effect of "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket" once per turn. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Detach 1 material from this card or destroy this card.
